pr_title: Split scheduler's PodInfo into two types, PodInfo and PodQueueInfo
pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**

/kind cleanup

**What this PR does / why we need it**:
Split scheduler's PodInfo into two types, PodInfo and PodQueueInfo. The first is used for scheduled pods, it will contain mutable pre-processed information such as inter-pod affinity selectors, it is created and maintained by NodeInfo, the latter is created by the queue to annotate it with timestamps and scheduling attempts.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
Fixes #89528

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:
```release-note
NONE
```

issue_context.title: Make PodInfo (a v1.Pod wrapper) a first class type in scheduler framework
issue_context.body:
**What would you like to be added**:
Currently we use a type named NodeInfo throughout the scheduler to represent a node type. This is simply a wrapper of v1.Node with some precomputed state (like pods currently scheduler on that node).

I am suggesting we add a similar type for pods named PodInfo that is returned by the scheduler's PodLister. PodInfo as a type already exist in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/scheduler/framework/v1alpha1/interface.go#L217, so we can reuse that type.

**Why is this needed**:
This will allow us to annotate v1.Pod type with precomputed state that can be useful for both performance and observability.

/sig scheduling
/assign

review_comments: just to confirm... we are not using this type yet, right?

We are, it is the type used by NodeInfo.Pods/NodeInfo.PodsWithAffinity. I will follow up with two PRs: 1) add the first pre-computed data (the pre-processed selectors), 2) change PodLister interface to PodInfoLister.
